payload.name: Extract every listed durable activity
payload.description: Use during candidate extraction when a single user message lists multiple distinct activities, facts, or experiences; create a candidate for each, not only the most prominent one.
content: When a message enumerates multiple distinct activities or facts (e.g., separated by commas or 'and'), extract one candidate per listed item that is durable and relevant, even if one item seems more significant.

Do not collapse an enumerated list into a single memory that drops secondary items; if items share a theme, either keep them as separate memories or explicitly include all items in the memory content.

solves: A construction extraction failure occurred because a message listing several career-development activities (studying, workshops, networking, conference presentation) yielded only one memory for the conference, so the workshop fact was lost. The reusable mechanism is selective extraction of one salient item from an enumeration. Apply during extraction whenever a single user message contains multiple distinct durable facts, even when one seems more prominent; the rule does not apply to merging or updating existing memories.
